spans.label: pub mod declarations for the trees directory
spans.note: This module models the CONTENTS of bit_path.rs, error.rs, get_root.rs and merkle_tree.rs but has no model of Rust module declaration or path resolution; incremental_merkle_tree, indexed_merkle_tree and sparse_merkle_tree are not modelled at all.

boundaries.name: rustc-module-resolution
boundaries.obligation: rustc path/module resolution, #[path] overrides and cfg evaluation are not modelled.

boundaries.name: unmodelled-sibling-trees
boundaries.obligation: incremental_merkle_tree.rs, indexed_merkle_tree/ and sparse_merkle_tree.rs wrap MerkleProof and are NOT modelled here; their extra invariants (append-only index, low-leaf ordering, key uniqueness) are undischarged.

boundaries.name: native-target-refinement
boundaries.obligation: The Lean definitions are a handwritten local semantics; no refinement of the Rust source is proved.
